subject: general
question: Pandit Ravi Shankar, a music legend is famous for which of the following styles of music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindustani classical instrumental**__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit ****Ravi Shankar** was an Indian sitarist and composer. 
 
• A sitar virtuoso, he became the world's best-known exponent of **North Indian classical music** in the second half of the **20th century**, and influenced many musicians in India and throughout the world.
 
• Legendary sitar player Pandit Ravi Shankar was born on **April 7, 1920.**
 
• **Ravi Shankar** was awarded India's highest civilian honor, the **Bharat Ratna** in 1999 and received** three Grammy Awards** for his outstanding work.
 
• 
 
Dubbed the "**Godfather of world music**" by George Harrison of the Beatles, he spent his youth touring Europe and India with the dance group of his brother Uday Shankar. He gave up dancing in 1938 to study sitar playing under court musician Allauddin Khan.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Instruments most commonly used in** Hindustani classical music **are the **sitar, sarod, tambura, sahnai, sarangi,** and** tabla, **While instruments commonly used in **Carnatic classical music** include the** vina, mrdangam, kanjira,** and **violin**.
